theme: Placing a transmitter from arrival-time differences
title: Listening Line: TDOA Localization with a Degenerate Array
strategies: trivial: ignore all TDOA data and report the receiver array's centroid for every held-out emitter -- matches the checker's own internal baseline exactly

greedy: estimate each receiver's clock bias by averaging over the calibration emitters (the obvious way to handle the nuisance), then for every held-out emitter plug the bias-corrected TDOA into the linear forward model and solve the 2x2 normal-equations least squares directly -- a single uniform recipe, blind to how conditioned the array's own geometry is

strong: same bias correction, but first eigendecompose the array's own geometry-only Gram matrix J^T J (no data needed) to read off its condition number; keep the ordinary least-squares value along the well-constrained eigen-direction, and on ill-conditioned (near-collinear) arrays substitute the calibration emitters' own centroid offset for the data-starved eigen-direction instead of trusting noise-amplified least squares -- truncated-SVD regularization in the array's natural eigenbasis, reducing to byte-identical greedy whenever the geometry is fine

headroom above strong: soft (not hard-threshold) shrinkage calibrated to the actual noise level rather than a fixed condition-number cutoff, a robust (not mean) calibration-centroid prior, and jointly re-estimating clock bias and position instead of a one-shot calibration pass
